theorem certElemOk_timeless (γ : RaftNames) (e : CertKey) : Timeless (certElemOk γ e)

theorem certElemOk_persistent (γ : RaftNames) (e : CertKey) : Persistent (certElemOk γ e)

theorem memCert_register [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : RaftNames) (γs : MemStorNames) (k :
    SnapTrip) (E : CoPset) (hE : ↑(raftCertN γ) ⊆ E) : ⊢ memCertInv γ γs -∗ raftSnapCertD γ k ={E}=∗
    memStorCert γs k

def memCertInv (γ : RaftNames) (γs : MemStorNames) : IProp GF :=
  inv (raftCertN γ) iprop(∃ L, monoListAuthOwn γs.cert 1 L ∗ [∗list] e ∈ L, certElemOk γ e)

theorem memCert_read [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : RaftNames) (γs : MemStorNames) (k : SnapTrip)
    (E : CoPset) (hE : ↑(raftCertN γ) ⊆ E) : ⊢ memCertInv γ γs -∗ memStorCert γs k ={E}=∗
    raftSnapCertD γ k

theorem memCert_registerAny [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : RaftNames) (γs : MemStorNames) (i :
    w64) (cl : CSLists) (al : Bool) (d : List w8) (E : CoPset) (hE : ↑(raftCertN γ) ⊆ E) : ⊢
    memCertInv γ γs -∗ (□ ∀ t, raftSnapCertD γ { sid := { term' := t, index' := i }, cl := cl, al :=
    al, dat := d }) ={E}=∗ □ ∀ t, memStorCert γs { sid := { term' := t, index' := i }, cl := cl, al
    := al, dat := d }

theorem memCertInv_alloc [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : RaftNames) (γs : MemStorNames) (E :
    CoPset) : ⊢ memCertAuth γs ={E}=∗ memCertInv γ γs

theorem memCertInv_persistent (γ : RaftNames) (γs : MemStorNames) : Persistent (memCertInv γ γs)

def certElemOk (γ : RaftNames) (e : CertKey) : IProp GF :=
  if e.snd = true then
    iprop(∀ t,
        raftSnapCertD γ
          { sid := { term' := t, index' := e.fst.sid.index' }, cl := e.fst.cl, al := e.fst.al, dat := e.fst.dat })
  else raftSnapCertD γ e.fst

theorem certElemOk_covers [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : RaftNames) (e : CertKey) (k : SnapTrip)
    (h : certCovers e k) : certElemOk γ e ⊢ raftSnapCertD γ k
